transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net billing customer services, my name is Jason. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Jason. My name is Declan Walsh. I cancelled my broadband contract three months ago in August, returned all equipment, and S-Net is still withdrawing fifty-four pounds from my bank every month!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning Declan. I can check your billing account ledger. Before we inspect your transaction history, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 28 Lansdowne Crescent, Cheltenham, GL50 2LF, and my security PIN is 9043. My customer account number is SN-991204.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Declan, that confirms your account details. What specific bank transactions are you seeing on your statement?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fifty-four pounds was taken on September 15th, October 15th, and again yesterday on November 15th! That is one hundred and sixty-two pounds stolen from my bank account after an agreed cancellation because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your account shows cancellation was submitted on the 10th of August, but the automated recurring direct debit mandate remained in active status on our central payment gateway in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I sent the router back in your pre-paid tracked bag, and Royal Mail delivered it to your warehouse on the 18th of August! Why was the direct debit not terminated immediately so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Equipment returns and recurring payment schedules run on separate backend financial databases.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't care how your internal databases work! You have unlawfully taken one hundred and sixty-two pounds of my money!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I retrieve your billing ledger archive from our legacy records system.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Declan. The archive indicates your final bill was generated with an outstanding pro-rata charge that prevented automatic closure of the mandate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I was told my final balance was zero pounds by your telephone agent in August! Now you take money without authorization! I have been pushed into an unarranged bank overdraft because of this, and Barclays charged me overdraft fees!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well if you had actually checked your monthly bank statements in September, you would have noticed the first collection and contacted us before three cycles ran.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How dare you blame me for your illegal direct debit collections! You shouldn't be raiding my bank account in the first place!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under banking rules, if you want immediate reimbursement, you need to contact Barclays directly to raise a direct debit indemnity claim rather than expecting customer services to issue manual refunds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you telling me that S-Net took my money erroneously and you refuse to refund it from your own billing terminal?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline customer service agents do not have direct electronic bank transfer permissions for closed accounts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then transfer me to your accounts manager who can authorize a direct refund to my debit card!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Floor supervisors cannot execute direct bank refunds either. You must file a written dispute with our executive billing office.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is the most appalling customer service I have ever experienced. I returned your property and you continue taking my money.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before checking the mandate cancellation status, that registered mobile number ending in 204 was 07700 900204, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 07700 900204 is my mobile.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously automated direct debit sweeps process according to bank clearing schedules, so manual interventions require formal supervisor ticket escalation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then escalate the ticket right now to cancel the mandate permanently so you cannot take another penny in December!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am submitting the mandate revocation command to Bacs right now. The electronic collection mandate will be purged from the clearing system within twenty-four hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you give me a formal cancellation reference code for my bank?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the direct debit mandate cancellation identifier is DDC-88419-X.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: DDC-88419-X, written down. And what about my one hundred and sixty-two pounds refund?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for two minutes while I submit an exceptional refund request to our finance ledger desk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Declan. My duty operations manager has authorized an exceptional automated card refund of one hundred and sixty-two pounds back to your registered Visa debit card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will that include compensation for my thirty pounds bank overdraft penalty charges?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We do not reimburse third-party banking overdraft fees under standard billing terms.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, at least refunding the hundred and sixty-two pounds gets my principal money back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The refund transaction has been posted. The funds will credit your Barclays current account within three to five business days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I see the email notification confirming the credit of one hundred and sixty-two pounds right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your direct debit mandate is cancelled, your final balance is confirmed zero, and the refund has been authorized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank goodness that is finally sorted. I will monitor my bank account to ensure the money arrives.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can also instruct Barclays to reject any future collection requests quoting reference SN-991204.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have already told my bank to block any future mandates from S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other matter regarding your closed account I can assist with today, Declan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your account profile will officially transition to permanent archived status once the card refund clears the banking network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood, please ensure all marketing and promotional communications are suppressed as well so I do not receive junk letters.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All marketing permissions have been revoked and your address is flagged on our suppression register.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that ensures total closure of this account.
